tasks.title: Add WorkflowRun command to schedule visible rebase work
tasks.description: Extend the WorkflowRun domain and application-service boundary so the current stage can append a single visible `rebase-branch` task and reopen an `awaiting-approval` stage back to `running` when executable work is added. The delivered capability is that a user-triggered rebase becomes canonical WorkflowRun state immediately, with idempotent duplicate-click handling and stage-state projection support.
acceptanceCriteria: The active WorkflowRun can append `rebase-branch` to the current stage with title, reason, and causedBy metadata without creating duplicate pending or running copies
If the current stage is `awaiting-approval`, scheduling `rebase-branch` returns the stage to `running` so `nextWork()` can return the new task
Stage-state and WorkflowRun projections show `Rebase branch` as a normal task after scheduling
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The change-local specs directory is empty today, so implementation should follow the accepted proposal/design until spec deltas are written. Keep the task id stable as `rebase-branch` rather than creating suffixed duplicates.

tasks.title: Execute `rebase-branch` through the shared task runtime and migrate the API entrypoint
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: Non-Build tasks execute through a minimal shared handler contract
tasks.description: Implement `rebase-branch` as a shared service-backed workflow task using the #199 task runtime and wire `POST /api/issues/:number/rebase` to schedule that task instead of enqueueing the legacy issue-queue `rebase` job for non-Done stages. The delivered capability is that rebase execution is owned by `WorkflowRun.nextWork()` and returns factual before/after SHA output through the normal task result path.
acceptanceCriteria: `rebase-branch` executes through the shared non-Build task runtime and returns factual output including base branch, before/after base SHA, before/after head SHA, and `shaChanged`
`WorkflowEngine` and the relevant stage runner can execute a requested `rebase-branch` task without adding a rebase-only runner path
`POST /api/issues/:number/rebase` schedules `rebase-branch` through WorkflowRun for non-Done stages instead of calling `agentRunner.enqueue(issue.id, 'rebase', ...)`
Done-stage retry or merge-queue behavior remains on its existing compatibility path
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Preserve existing rebase SSE events if helpful for compatibility, but make them secondary to canonical WorkflowRun task state. Do not read or honor `reEvalPlan` in the new task handler.

tasks.title: Add SHA-change invalidation policy for completed rebase tasks
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-engine/spec.md#Requirement: merge-ready invalidates review on code change
tasks.description: Teach the WorkflowRun domain to interpret completed `rebase-branch` output and invalidate only the affected task, check, and approval state when `shaChanged=true`. The delivered capability is that review or approval state changes come from the rebase facts recorded in task output rather than from the user click or from legacy queue-side policy branches.
acceptanceCriteria: When `rebase-branch` completes with `shaChanged=false`, previously completed review or check state remains valid and workflow continues normally
When `rebase-branch` completes with `shaChanged=true` in Check, `ai-review`, `review-passed`, `merge-ready`, and approval state are invalidated and return to pending before later work resumes
A failed `rebase-branch` causes the current stage and workflow to fail through normal task failure semantics, and later tasks or checks do not execute
Legacy rebase follow-up logic no longer decides re-review or approval invalidation for the Web/API primary path
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the reset list explicit per stage. This issue must not reintroduce build-to-plan rewinds or task regeneration policy under the new rebase path.

tasks.title: Update the issue detail rebase UX to follow canonical task state
tasks.description: Update the frontend rebase action flow so clicking Rebase refreshes and renders the canonical stage task list, where `Rebase branch` appears as a normal pending, running, completed, or failed task. The delivered capability is that users understand rebase as workflow work rather than as a toast- or SSE-only side action, while any retained rebase SSE remains supplemental progress detail.
acceptanceCriteria: After the rebase action succeeds in scheduling, Issue Detail shows `Rebase branch` in the current stage task list without waiting for a bespoke rebase event interpretation
The UI renders `Rebase branch` status transitions from the same stage-state or WorkflowRun-backed task data used for other tasks
The rebase action no longer depends on queue-job semantics or assumes the backend performs the rebase inline during the POST request for non-Done stages
Any retained rebase progress or conflict messaging is secondary to canonical task-list state rather than replacing it
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Preserve Done-stage rebase-and-retry UX, but non-Done stages should now communicate success as 'task scheduled' followed by canonical task-state updates.

tasks.title: Lock visible rebase workflow behavior with regression coverage
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Requirement: API 提供操作接口
tasks.description: Add focused backend and frontend regression coverage for the new visible rebase workflow path: task scheduling, approval-stage reopen, shared runtime execution, SHA-change invalidation, API behavior, and issue-detail rendering. The delivered capability is that future workflow refactors can change internals without regressing the user-visible contract that rebase is ordinary WorkflowRun work.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests cover duplicate-click idempotency, approval-stage reopen, `nextWork()` returning `rebase-branch`, task failure blocking, and `shaChanged=false` vs `shaChanged=true` invalidation behavior
API tests cover non-Done rebase scheduling through WorkflowRun and confirm the primary path no longer relies on legacy `taskType='rebase'` queue execution
Frontend tests cover Issue Detail showing `Rebase branch` from canonical task state after scheduling and through status transitions
Relevant test suites pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused contract tests over broad end-to-end rewrites. Coverage should prove that rebase visibility and invalidation semantics come from WorkflowRun state, not from SSE-only progress handling.
